record.original_question: For the Z_k-equivariant differential equations z' = iz + (z zbar)^n zbar^{k+1} with positive integers n and k, is the period function of the period annulus at the origin monotonically decreasing?

evidence.quote: Problem 16. Is the period function associated to the period annulus of the origin of the differential equation z' = iz + (zzbar)^n zbar^{k+1}, with n and k a positive integers, monotonous decreasing?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n$ and $k$ be positive integers, and consider the planar differential equation in complex form
$$\dot z \;=\; i\,z \;+\; (z ar z)^{n}\, ar z^{\,k+1},\qquad z\in\mathbb{C},$$
which is $\mathbb{Z}_k$-equivariant and has a center at the origin surrounded by a period annulus $\mathcal{P}$ (the maximal punctured neighborhood of the origin foliated by periodic orbits). For each periodic orbit $\gamma_c\subset\mathcal{P}$ parametrized by an energy/amplitude parameter $c$, let $T(c)$ denote its minimal period, and call $T:\mathcal{P}	o(0,\infty)$ the period function of the center.

Prove or disprove: for every choice of positive integers $n$ and $k$, the period function $T$ is strictly monotonically decreasing along the period annulus (as one moves outward from the origin).
artifact.status_search_result: A 2025 paper by A. Gasull and D. Rojas, "Monotonous Period Function for Equivariant Differential Equations with Homogeneous Nonlinearities" (Mediterranean Journal of Mathematics), proves that the period function of the center at the origin of the $\mathbb{Z}_k$-equivariant equation $\dot z = iz + a(z\bar z)^n z^{k+1}$ is monotonically decreasing for all positive integers $n,k$ (and any $a\neq 0$). This form is equivalent to the $\bar z^{k+1}$ formulation via complex conjugation/time reversal, so the conjecture is settled affirmatively.

status_evidence.title: Monotonous Period Function for Equivariant Differential Equations with Homogeneous Nonlinearities
status_evidence.snippet: Proves that the period function of the center at the origin of the Z_k-equivariant differential equation ż = iz + a(z z̄)^n z^{k+1} is monotonously decreasing for all positive integers n and k.
status_evidence.claim: The conjectured monotonic decrease of the period function is proven.

status_evidence.title: Gasull, Rojas — SSRN preprint
status_evidence.snippet: Same result, established as a corollary of monotonicity of the period function of a sub-family of reversible quadratic centers.
